evConversionPlans: The Dortmund facility produces the City 45 Electric and City 75 Electric minibuses. Under the ownership of RESVION, the site has expanded across Europe and scaled production to 1,200 units annually through 2026.
name: AEQUITA Dortmund

evConversionPlans: ATP Trucks Automobile is constructing a second assembly plant in Baia Mare. The facility features two production halls totaling 31,000 sqm and is dedicated to the assembly of electric and hydrogen trucks and buses.
name: ATP EXODUS GROUP Baia Mare

evConversionPlans: Automobiles Gillet is developing the Tensity E-Truck, a compact electric light commercial vehicle for urban deliveries. The van features a 45 kWh battery with an estimated 250 km range and utilizes Dacia Spring powertrain components.
name: AUTOMOBILES GILLET Gembloux

evConversionPlans: Autosan is expanding its zero-emission lineup with a new series of electric and intercity buses that were planned for a 2025 launch. This follows the 2024 completion of the Autoelektrosan project, which introduced an innovative external battery and drivetrain module.
name: AUTOSAN Sanok

source: Ministry of Industry and Tourism (MINTUR) - PERTE VEC II Resolutions
evConversionPlans: Carrocerías Ayats manufactures lightweight electric buses at its Arbúcies site using an industrial process supported by the PERTE VEC II program. The facility also features a dedicated workshop for converting diesel buses into electric vehicles.
name: AYATS Arbúcies

evConversionPlans: Beulas produces zero-emission buses, including the 12-meter electric intercity model and the Jewel E electric double-decker. The company also develops green hydrogen intercity coaches through the Future BusH project.
name: BEULAS S.A.U. Arbúcies

evConversionPlans: The Ciorogârla plant produces EuroBus Diamond electric buses and minibuses with an initial capacity of 200 units per year. A second facility was planned to increase total production capacity to 700-800 electric vehicles annually for domestic and European markets.
name: BMC GROUP Ciorogârla (Bucharest)

evConversionPlans: BMW Group Plant Dingolfing produces electric models including the i5, iX, and i7, with a target set in 2024 for EVs to reach 40% of total output. A new facility in Irlbach-Straßkirchen is scheduled to begin supplying 6th-generation batteries for Neue Klasse models in late 2026.
name: BMW GROUP Dingolfing

brands: Electric motors and range extender; Hydrogen-electric drive train
evConversionPlans: The Landshut plant manufactures aluminum housings for Neue Klasse electric drive units in a 12,000-square-meter facility. As of mid-2026, the site has begun series production of the Energy Master central control unit interface.
name: BMW GROUP Ergolding (Landshut)

evConversionPlans: The Leipzig plant produces up to 300,000 high-voltage batteries annually for the MINI Countryman Electric and BMW iX1, i4, i5, and iX models. The facility manages the full process chain from cell coating to final assembly and operates a dedicated battery logistics center.
name: BMW GROUP Leipzig

evConversionPlans: BMW Group Regensburg assembles the fully electric iX1 and iX2 models. The site has expanded with a new battery testing center in Wackersdorf and a high-voltage battery assembly plant in Irlbach-Straszkirchen to support the production of Neue Klasse electric vehicles starting in 2026.
name: BMW GROUP Regensburg

brands: Diesel and petrol engines for BMW and MINI
evConversionPlans: The BMW Steyr plant produces sixth-generation electric drives for Neue Klasse vehicles. The facility manufactures rotors, stators, transmissions, and inverters with an annual capacity of 600,000 units. Full series production commenced in August 2025.
name: BMW GROUP Steyr

source: Ministère de l'Économie, des Finances et de la Souveraineté industrielle et numérique
evConversionPlans: Blue Solutions is expanding its Ergué-Gabéric facility to include an advanced R&D center and a pilot line for 4th generation solid-state lithium-metal batteries. Construction commenced in 2026, creating 230 new jobs at the site.
name: BOLLORE Ergué-Gabéric

evConversionPlans: The Molsheim headquarters features a 2,120-square-meter facility for assembling next-generation hybrid hypercars like the V16 Tourbillon. While Rimac Technology supplies the EV batteries and powertrains, this site focuses on final systems integration and assembly. Construction on the expansion was scheduled to commence in late 2024.
name: BUGATTI RIMAC Molsheim

evConversionPlans: BYD has tripled its capacity at this facility to produce 1,250 electric buses and trucks annually, a target set for 2025. The site includes a 29,000-square-meter production plant and an R&D test lab, while other Hungarian locations manage passenger EV and battery production.
name: BYD Komaróm

evConversionPlans: The Solaris Bus & Coach facility in Bolechowo is a leading electric bus manufacturer. Ongoing investments through 2026 include new equipment and vehicle finishing platforms to increase production capacity for zero-emission buses.
name: CAF GROUP Bolechowo

evConversionPlans: The Santiago de Compostela facility produces electric bus bodies and has fully electrified its commercial range. The site scales EV production through a partnership with Yutong and assembles buses using chassis from BYD, Volvo, and Scania. Castrosua also recently launched the Neno nano electric vehicle.
name: CASTROSUA Santiago de Compostela

evConversionPlans: DAF Trucks operates a 5,000-square-meter Electric Truck Assembly Plant in Eindhoven. The facility produces battery-electric DAF XD, XF, and XB models, with an annual capacity of thousands of zero-emission trucks.
name: DAF TRUCKS NV Eindhoven

evConversionPlans: The Ligny-en-Barrois plant is Daimler Truck's largest European electric bus production center. Production of the Mercedes eCitaro commenced in June 2024, with the facility aiming for 100% electric bus production by 2030.
name: DAIMLER TRUCK Ligny-en-Barrois

brands: Mercedes-Benz, EvoBus; truck engines; battery packs (InnoLab Battery)
evConversionPlans: The Mannheim plant is a competence center for battery technologies and high-voltage systems. Since 2024, the facility has focused exclusively on producing fully electric city buses, including the eCitaro. Series production of next-generation batteries is planned for the late 2020s.
name: DAIMLER TRUCK Mannheim

evConversionPlans: The Molsheim facility produces pre-series electric heavy-duty vehicles and prototypes, including the eActros 300 lowliner. Following the production of over 100 electric units in 2023, the site underwent structural transformations, including new tooling and staff training, to scale up electric vehicle operations.
name: DAIMLER TRUCK Molsheim

evConversionPlans: The Neu-Ulm plant is scheduled to begin production of fully electric intercity buses in the second half of the decade. Plans include expanding to battery-electric and hydrogen fuel cell coaches by 2030, with bus bodyshell construction moving to the Czech Republic starting in 2028.
name: DAIMLER TRUCK Neu-Ulm

evConversionPlans: The Tramagal facility mass produces the FUSO eCanter electric truck. Production through 2026 includes an expanded electric portfolio with specialized chassis configurations and vehicle exports to new international markets.
name: DAIMLER TRUCK Tramagal

evConversionPlans: The Wörth plant is Daimler Truck's hub for emission-free transport, producing the eActros 600 and eActros 400. In 2026, the facility is commissioning Megawatt Charging Systems, fully electrifying inbound logistics, and beginning assembly of 100 hydrogen fuel-cell trucks.
name: DAIMLER TRUCK Wörth

evConversionPlans: The Macchia d'Isernia plant serves as an advanced industrial hub for electric and hybrid vehicle assembly. The facility expansion included new production lines and the creation of 300 jobs.
name: DR MOTOR Macchia d'Isernia

evConversionPlans: The Cléon headquarters serves as a dedicated manufacturing plant for the all-electric Ebusco 3.0. The facility is currently scaling toward a target production capacity of 500 electric buses annually for the French and Southern European markets.
name: EBUSCO Cléon

evConversionPlans: EVUM Motors' facility produces the aCar, a fully electric commercial vehicle. Following a 2023 funding round, the company filed for insolvency in April 2025, leading to the suspension of all future expansion projects.
name: EVUM MOTORS Bayerbach bei Ergoldsbach

evConversionPlans: The Maranello e-building is a 42,500-square-meter facility dedicated to Ferrari's first fully electric vehicle, which began production in early 2026. The site handles the in-house design and assembly of electric motors, high-voltage batteries, and axles, alongside internal combustion and hybrid models.
name: FERRARI Maranello

evConversionPlans: The Craiova facility produces the Puma Gen-E, E-Transit Courier, and E-Tourneo Courier. A battery assembly line opened in October 2024, with the first customer deliveries of electric vehicles having commenced in March 2025.
name: FORD OF EUROPE Craiova

evConversionPlans: The Ford Cologne Electric Vehicle Center is Ford’s first dedicated EV facility in Europe, with an annual capacity of over 250,000 vehicles. The site produces the all-electric Ford Explorer and Ford Capri sports crossover, alongside battery pack assembly.
name: FORD OF EUROPE Köln

evConversionPlans: Ford's Valencia plant is scheduled to begin production of a new multi-energy passenger SUV in 2027, with a target of 300,000 units annually. The site includes a dedicated battery assembly plant established with support from the Spanish government’s PERTE VEC II program.
name: FORD OF EUROPE Valencia (Almusafes)

evConversionPlans: The Ostfildern plant focuses on electromobility, producing prototype plants and turnkey production lines for hairpin stators and electric motors. Through its E-Motive division and a strategic alliance with WAFIOS, the facility has developed advanced electric motor production solutions for the global automotive industry through 2026.
name: GEHRING Ostfildern

evConversionPlans: The Veenendaal facility has produced battery electric trucks since 2013. The site retrofits heavy-duty vehicles, such as concrete mixers and tippers, into hydrogen fuel-cell electric trucks and is finalizing its first hydrogen fuel-cell tractor unit.
name: GINAF Veenendaal

evConversionPlans: The Montmeló facility is dedicated to manufacturing electric hypercars and battery components through 2026. In June 2024, Hispano Suiza launched the Carmen Sagrera EV hypercar, which utilizes a 103 kWh second-generation battery pack developed and produced entirely on-site.
name: HISPANO SUIZA Montmeló (Barcelona)

evConversionPlans: The Žilina plant produces the EV4 electric hatchback and began manufacturing the EV2 compact SUV in 2026. As Kia's first European site for E-GMP platform vehicles, the facility aims to produce 180,000 electric vehicles annually by 2027.
name: HYUNDAI MOTOR GROUP Zilina

evConversionPlans: Hyundai Motor Manufacturing Czech is the primary European hub for electric vehicles, producing the Kona Electric and the Inster EV. The facility operates a Battery System Assembly plant with an annual capacity of 450,000 units to support multiple European production sites.
investmentAmount: Over €2 billion invested in Nošovice site
name: HYUNDAI MOTOR EUROPE Nosovice

evConversionPlans: ICAP Group, through Tecnobus, converted the former Valeo plant in Ferentino into an electric minibus production facility. The site leverages existing industrial capabilities to meet sustainable mobility demand with a workforce of over 150 employees.
name: ICAP GROUP Frosinone

source: Ministry of Enterprises and Made in Italy (MIMIT)
evConversionPlans: Menarini is transitioning to 100% electric bus production under an industrial plan that commenced in 2024. All mass production of electric vehicles and batteries is consolidated at the Flumeri plant, while the Bologna facility focuses on R&D, prototyping, and design.
name: INDUSTRIA ITALIANA AUTOBUS Bologna

evConversionPlans: Following its acquisition by Seri Industrial, Menarini transitioned its Flumeri assembly site to full electric bus production. Supported by a technical partnership with Geely Group, the facility focuses entirely on manufacturing electric models and components.
name: INDUSTRIA ITALIANA AUTOBUS Flumeri

evConversionPlans: The Aduna facility is a dedicated electromobility plant producing electric buses, trucks, and battery packs. Under the PERTE VEC II program, the site is finishing development of a new generation of electric coaches and advanced EV materials through 2026.
name: IRIZAR Aduna

evConversionPlans: The Lazkao facility is a 2,200 m2 production plant dedicated to the 100% electric Irizar ie truck. Opened in early 2023 with an initial capacity of 60 trucks per year, the site began production of second-generation electric trucks in May 2024.
name: IRIZAR Lazkao

evConversionPlans: The Ormaiztegi headquarters produces zero-emission intercity and long-distance coaches, including the electric i3 and hydrogen-powered i6S Efficient. As part of the PERTE VEC CAPITAL project, the company developed new electric platforms and battery systems through 2025.
name: IRIZAR Ormaiztegi

evConversionPlans: The Annonay plant produces HEULIEZ GX ELEC, IVECO E-WAY, and E-WAY-H2 hydrogen fuel cell buses. The facility features a dedicated battery assembly line for latest-generation batteries and manages the full electric value chain.
name: IVECO GROUP Annonay

evConversionPlans: The IVECO Brescia plant electrifies eDaily vans and produces eJolly and eSuperJolly electric models. The facility also manufactures Daily Minibuses and tests dynamic wireless inductive charging technologies.
name: IVECO GROUP Brescia

evConversionPlans: The Foggia plant assembles battery electric and hydrogen fuel cell buses, with a target of 4,000 total vehicles produced by 2026. EV development at the Foggia and Turin facilities was accelerated through 2025 using European Investment Bank funding.
name: IVECO GROUP Foggia

evConversionPlans: The IVECO Madrid facility is transitioning to zero-emission vehicle production with support from Spain's PERTE VEC III program. As part of the Poseidon initiative, the site develops and manufactures hydrogen-powered heavy commercial vehicles and fuel cell pilots.
name: IVECO GROUP Madrid

evConversionPlans: The Rorthais facility is IVECO’s electromobility hub, producing HEULIEZ GX ELEC and IVECO E-WAY electric buses. Since 2024, the site has fulfilled major contracts for Paris and Nantes while introducing production lines for new E-WAY-H2 hydrogen fuel cell models.
name: IVECO GROUP Rorthais

evConversionPlans: The Suzzara plant produces the base chassis and body for the eDaily. Starting in 2026, the facility also assembles new electric vans through a partnership with Stellantis, with final battery integration completed at the Brescia facility.
name: IVECO GROUP Suzzara

evConversionPlans: The Ulm facility is a dedicated manufacturing hub for heavy-duty electric and fuel-cell trucks, specifically the IVECO S-eWay models. Following its transition from a joint venture with Nikola to full IVECO ownership, the plant commenced scheduled deliveries in 2024 and 2025.
name: IVECO GROUP Ulm

evConversionPlans: The Vysoké Mýto plant focuses on zero-emission public transport, manufacturing the battery-electric Crossway Low Entry and Crossway Normal Floor models. A Prototype and Testing Center, which became operational in June 2025, supports the ongoing development of battery-electric and hydrogen-powered vehicles.
name: IVECO GROUP Vysoké Myto

evConversionPlans: Jaguar Land Rover is reconfiguring its Nitra plant to produce electric vehicles by 2030 as part of its Reimagine Strategy. The facility is scheduled to launch nine all-electric models, including EV versions of the Defender and Discovery.
name: JAGUAR LAND ROVER Nitra

evConversionPlans: The Kravtex-Kühne Group produces the Credobus Electronell, a 100% electric bus family including 12-meter and 18-meter models. Components are manufactured in Mosonmagyaróvár with final assembly in Győr. The company is currently conducting passenger testing and preparing for series production to supply Hungarian public transport operators.
name: KRAVTEX-KÜHNE GROUP Győr

evConversionPlans: Leclanché's Willstätt facility has expanded to an annual production capacity of 2 GWh. The plant produces proprietary water-based, PFAS-free lithium-ion battery cells for electric vehicles and heavy-duty transport.
name: LECLANCHÉ Willstätt

evConversionPlans: Magna Steyr's Graz facility is a hub for electric vehicle production, including the assembly of Xpeng G6, Xpeng G9, and GAC Aion V SUVs. The site is currently launching production of Volkswagen's Scout EV SUV and pickup models.
name: MAGNA STEYR Graz

evConversionPlans: The Mercedes-Benz Berlin plant is a competence center for e-mobility and digitalization. The facility assembles battery electrical control units and electric drive units, and recently expanded its portfolio to include the manufacture and assembly of ultra-high-performance axial-flux electric motors.
name: MERCEDES-BENZ GROUP Berlin

evConversionPlans: The Mercedes-Benz Bremen facility is the lead plant for compact EV production using the Modular Architecture (MMA) platform. Production is scheduled to begin in late 2026.
name: MERCEDES-BENZ GROUP Bremen

evConversionPlans: The Düsseldorf plant produces the next-generation eSprinter and open body style electric vans. These vehicles are based on the VAN.EA platform, which was scheduled to launch in 2026.
name: MERCEDES-BENZ GROUP Düsseldorf

evConversionPlans: The Kecskemét plant follows an Electric Only strategy, utilizing the MMA and MB.EA platforms for models like the GLB. The site features a battery assembly facility and an R&D center for EV prototype testing, with expanded series production commenced in 2025-2026.
name: MERCEDES-BENZ GROUP Kecskemet

evConversionPlans: The Ludwigsfelde plant produces eSprinter cab-chassis variants and serves as a center for eVan customization. The facility launched the start-up factory for the VAN.EA modular electric platform in 2026, with eSprinter production scheduled to phase out by the end of 2029.
name: MERCEDES-BENZ GROUP Ludwigsfelde

evConversionPlans: The Rastatt plant produces the all-electric CLA, the first model on the Mercedes Modular Architecture (MMA) platform. The facility uses flexible assembly lines to manufacture electric, hybrid, and conventional vehicles. Series production of the electric CLA commenced in mid-2025.
name: MERCEDES-BENZ GROUP Rastatt

evConversionPlans: The Sindelfingen plant serves as the lead facility for Mercedes-Benz's Top End Luxury segment. Production of electric models based on the high-performance AMG.EA platform and operations at a new EV battery factory were scheduled to commence in 2025.
investmentAmount: Hundreds of millions for Sindelfingen conversion
name: MERCEDES-BENZ GROUP Sindelfingen

evConversionPlans: Mercedes-Benz has upgraded its Vitoria plant to produce the all-electric VLE van using the modular Van Electric Architecture (VAN.EA). The facility features a modernized assembly hall for both electric and combustion models, with full EV production having commenced in the first half of 2026.
name: MERCEDES-BENZ GROUP Vitoria

evConversionPlans: MOL CY produces electric heavy-duty vehicles at its Staden facility, including the RME225 RoRo terminal tractor and RailRoute vehicles. The plant continues to manufacture diesel and military vehicles alongside its electric lineup.
name: MOL CY Staden

evConversionPlans: Piaggio's Pontedera plant produces electric motors for next-generation zero-emission vehicles and manufactures the Porter NPE, the company's first fully electric light commercial truck. The facility also serves as a hub for research and development of EV components and systems.
name: PIAGGIO Pontedera (Pisa)

evConversionPlans: The Passignano sul Trasimeno facility is a zero-emission plant producing Eltron and Sixtron electric buses and Hydron hydrogen buses. Since its expansion in 2024, the site has also included the H2EUPower division for developing hydrogen fuel cell power systems.
name: RAMPINI Passignano sul Trasimeno

evConversionPlans: The Batilly (SOVAB) plant produces the all-electric Renault Master E-Tech. Production of the Renault Master H2-Tech, a hydrogen fuel-cell commercial van, commenced in late 2025 on the same multi-energy assembly line.
name: RENAULT (SOVAB) Batilly (Metz)

evConversionPlans: The Manufacture Alpine Dieppe Jean Redele plant has been converted to produce electric vehicles on the CMF-EV platform. Production of the Alpine A390, an all-electric sport fastback, was scheduled to commence at the facility in 2025.
name: RENAULT GROUP Dieppe

evConversionPlans: The Douai facility is a 100% electric vehicle production site within Renault's Ampere ElectriCity hub, manufacturing the Megane E-Tech, Scénic E-Tech, and Renault 5 E-Tech, alongside Nissan and Mitsubishi models. An on-site battery gigafactory with Envision AESC launched with an initial capacity of 9 GWh in 2024 and is expanding to 30 GWh by 2030.
name: RENAULT GROUP Douai

evConversionPlans: Renault's Flins plant has transitioned to a Re-Factory dedicated to the circular economy. The site remanufactures and reconditions over 3,000 EV components annually, including motors, power electronics, and traction batteries.
name: RENAULT GROUP Flins

evConversionPlans: The Maubeuge facility is a core component of Renault's ElectriCity hub, assembling the Renault 4 E-Tech and Kangoo E-Tech electric models. The site features an integrated battery assembly workshop and produces electric commercial vans for partners Nissan and Mercedes-Benz.
name: RENAULT GROUP Maubeuge

evConversionPlans: The Revoz plant in Novo Mesto produces the Twingo E-Tech Electric. As part of the E-Move consortium, the facility manufactures electric vehicle bodies, chassis, and powertrains.
name: RENAULT GROUP Novo Mesto

evConversionPlans: Renault Group's Palencia plant is scheduled to begin manufacturing next-generation C-segment and D-segment electric vehicles in 2027 or 2028. The facility will produce up to three electric models based on the AmpR Medium 800-volt platform and includes a new EV battery assembly project.
name: RENAULT GROUP Palencia

evConversionPlans: The Sandouville plant manufactures a new generation of all-electric light commercial vehicles using a connected 800V skateboard platform. Production commenced in 2026, beginning with the Renault Trafic Van E-Tech electric.
name: RENAULT GROUP Sandouville

evConversionPlans: The Valladolid plant produces 100% electric vehicle batteries and plug-in hybrid electric vehicle engines. Battery assembly was established with support from the Spanish government's PERTE VEC II program, while the HORSE joint venture manages the hybrid engine production line.
name: RENAULT GROUP Valladolid

brands: Rimac electric hypercars; Battery packs; Electric powertrain systems
evConversionPlans: The Rimac Campus in Sveta Nedelja is a 75,000 sq m facility dedicated to EV production, components, and batteries. The site assembles the Nevera and Nevera R electric hypercars while serving as an R&D hub for Rimac Technology. It produces high-volume battery projects for European automakers, including BMW, alongside solid-state batteries and e-axle drive units.
name: RIMAC GROUP Sveta Nedjelja

evConversionPlans: The Brașov facility, under Autovehicule DAC S.A., relaunched the DAC brand in 2025 for exclusive electric vehicle production. The site assembles electric buses, urban logistics and sanitation trucks, and mining dump trucks from CKD kits, targeting 30,000 EV sales by 2035.
name: ROMAN Braşov

evConversionPlans: The Safra New Mobility site in Albi produces battery-electric and hydrogen vehicles. The battery-electric HYCITY bus launched in late 2025, and production of the INYCIA minibus and EVANYA electric van commenced in early 2026.
name: SAFRA Albi

source: SeeNews / SIN CARS Industry AD Public Offering Memorandum
evConversionPlans: SIN CARS is constructing a manufacturing plant in Giurgiu, Romania, for 'L CITY' electric vehicles. The first phase is scheduled for completion by December 2026 with an initial capacity of 3,000 units per year, scaling to 100,000 units annually by 2030.
name: SIN CARS Giurgiu

evConversionPlans: The Škoda Group site in Plzeň is a dedicated electric mobility manufacturing facility. It produces electric buses, battery trolleybuses, battery electric multiple units, and traction drives, with no further conversion plans for the 2024-2026 period.
name: SKODA GROUP Plzeň

evConversionPlans: The Libchavy facility produces battery electric buses and trolleybuses as part of its established production line. There were no plans to convert the facility during the 2024-2026 period as EV production was already fully integrated.
name: SOR Libchavy

brands: Peugeot, Citroën, Opel/Vauxhall, Fiat and Toyota; battery packs
evConversionPlans: The Hordain facility produces battery-electric light commercial vehicles on a multi-energy production line. While the plant originally planned to assemble hydrogen fuel cell vans, Stellantis canceled the program in 2025 to focus exclusively on battery-electric and hybrid vehicle production.
name: STELLANTIS (SEVELNORD) Hordain

evConversionPlans: The Atessa facility produces large electric vans, including the Fiat E-Ducato and Cargo Box BEV. A partnership between Stellantis and IVECO includes the production of two new all-electric light commercial vehicles, which commenced in mid-2026.
name: STELLANTIS (SEVELSUD) Val di Sangro (Atessa)

evConversionPlans: The Cassino plant uses the BEV-centric STLA Large platform. Production of the next-generation Alfa Romeo Stelvio SUV was scheduled to begin in 2025, with the Alfa Romeo Giulia replacement and an additional luxury model following in 2026.
investmentAmount: Part of €2 billion Italian facility investment
name: STELLANTIS Cassino

brands: Electric, petrol and diesel for Peugeot, Citroen, Opel/Vauxhall and DS
evConversionPlans: The Douvrin gigafactory, operated by Automotive Cells Company (ACC), produces lithium-ion battery cells and modules. Since its 2023 opening, the site has expanded with a second production block to increase manufacturing capacity.
name: STELLANTIS Douvrin

evConversionPlans: The Eisenach Assembly Plant produces the electric successor to the Opel Grandland, with production having commenced in late 2024. The facility utilizes the STLA Medium platform to support Opel’s transition to an all-electric European lineup by 2028.
name: STELLANTIS Eisenach

evConversionPlans: The Gliwice plant is a hub for Stellantis electric light commercial vehicles, producing the Fiat Professional e-Ducato and battery-electric vans for Toyota. In partnership with IVECO, the facility launched two new all-electric LCVs in mid-2026. The site focuses exclusively on battery-electric and hybrid mobility.
name: STELLANTIS Gliwice

evConversionPlans: Stellantis Madrid produces the Citroen e-C4 and e-C4 X models. The facility features a battery assembly workshop with a 50,000-unit annual capacity and has expanded with a third assembly line. Through the ARIES project, the site began developing next-generation electric vehicles and sustainable energy solutions in 2025.
name: STELLANTIS Madrid (Villaverde)

evConversionPlans: The Mangualde facility produces battery-electric light commercial vehicles and passenger vans for Citroen, Fiat, Opel, and Peugeot. Following the installation of a new battery assembly line, mass production was scheduled to scale up between 2024 and 2025.
name: STELLANTIS Mangualde

evConversionPlans: The Melfi plant was upgraded to the STLA Medium platform for a 2025 production launch. The facility produces electric and hybrid versions of the Jeep Compass, Lancia Gamma, and DS 7, alongside the all-electric DS 8.
name: STELLANTIS Melfi (Potenza)

brands: Abarth, Fiat, Maserati; Electric drive motors
evConversionPlans: The Mirafiori Automotive Park 2030 features a Battery Technology Center and produces up to 600,000 electrified dual-clutch transmissions annually. The site manufactures the electric Fiat 500e and introduced the hybrid Fiat 500 Ibrida in early 2026.
name: STELLANTIS Mirafiori (Torino)

evConversionPlans: The Modena plant is a bespoke vehicle hub for Stellantis. As of late 2025, the facility produces the all-electric Maserati GranTurismo and GranCabrio Folgore models following their transfer from the Mirafiori plant.
name: STELLANTIS Modena

brands: DS, Peugeot; Assembly of drive batteries
evConversionPlans: The Mulhouse plant produces the Peugeot e-308 sedan, e-308 SW, and e-408. A partnership with Vulcan Energy Resources is implementing a geothermal energy project to decarbonize the facility's power supply starting in 2026.
name: STELLANTIS Mulhouse

evConversionPlans: The Poissy plant produces the DS 3 E-TENSE and Opel Mokka Electric on a multi-energy platform. A €20 million investment for metal work and recycling was announced in 2025, though the site is not a dedicated EV or battery facility. A decision regarding production beyond 2028 was expected in early 2026.
name: STELLANTIS Poissy

evConversionPlans: The Pomigliano d'Arco plant is scheduled to introduce the multi-energy STLA Small platform in 2028 to produce at least two new compact models with EV options. The facility continues to manufacture the Fiat Panda through 2030, with no current plans for a full EV transition or battery gigafactory.
name: STELLANTIS Pomigliano d'Arco (Napoli)

evConversionPlans: The Rennes facility produces the CR3 all-electric SUV using the STLA Medium platform, with production having commenced in 2025. The site features an in-house battery assembly workshop and a dedicated plastic injection molding facility.
name: STELLANTIS Rennes

evConversionPlans: The Rüsselsheim facility produces the Opel Astra Electric and DS 4 with an in-house battery assembly shop. Stellantis developed the carbon-neutral grEEn-campus at the site, with geothermal renewable energy for power and heat that was planned to commence in 2025.
name: STELLANTIS Rüsselsheim

evConversionPlans: The Sochaux facility produces electric vehicles on the STLA Medium platform, including the Peugeot e-3008 and e-5008 models launched between 2024 and 2026. The site also features a dedicated battery assembly workshop.
name: STELLANTIS Sochaux

evConversionPlans: Stellantis is expanding its Szentgotthárd facility to produce 3-in-1 electric drive modules (EDMs) for vehicles on the STLA platform. Production of electric motor, reduction gearset, and inverter components is scheduled to begin in late 2026.
name: STELLANTIS Szentgotthárd

evConversionPlans: The Trémery plant has transitioned from diesel engine production to mass-producing electric vehicle motors via the Emotors joint venture. Since 2024, the facility has been scaling capacity to exceed 1 million electric motors per year to support the Stellantis EV lineup.
name: STELLANTIS Trémery

evConversionPlans: The Trnava plant produces the all-electric Citroen e-C3 on the Smart Car platform, having reached full production capacity in 2024. The site is under evaluation for Leapmotor electric crossover production and utilizes a 25 MW battery energy storage system and solar array for sustainable operations.
name: STELLANTIS Trnava

evConversionPlans: The Dortmund facility produces the City 45 Electric and City 75 Electric minibuses. Owned by RESVION, the site has expanded across Europe and reached a production capacity of 1,200 units annually.
name: STELLANTIS Tychy

brands: Citroën, Fiat, Peugeot, Opel/Vauxhall, Toyota; Electric motors; Lithium-ion battery packs
evConversionPlans: The Vigo assembly plant produces compact electric vehicles using the BEV-native STLA Small platform. The facility features a dedicated EV battery production line established with support from the PERTE VEC II program.
name: STELLANTIS Vigo

brands: Citroën, Lancia, Opel/Vauxhall, Peugeot; Lithium-ion batteries
evConversionPlans: Stellantis and CATL are establishing a carbon-neutral lithium iron phosphate (LFP) battery plant at the Zaragoza facility. Production is slated to begin by late 2026 with a potential capacity of 50 GWh to support affordable electric vehicle production. The project is supported by nearly €300 million in Spanish government subsidies.
name: STELLANTIS Zaragoza

evConversionPlans: Steyr Automotive serves as a contract manufacturer for electric heavy-duty vehicles, including the Volta Zero electric truck. The facility also acts as a production partner for Chinese brands SuperPanther and Sinotruk to supply the European market.
name: STEYR AUTOMOTIVE Steyr

evConversionPlans: Sunsundegui had intended to begin electric vehicle production in 2024 through a partnership with Volvo. However, the company entered liquidation in April 2025, resulting in the cessation of all operations and the cancellation of its EV conversion plans.
name: SUNSUNDEGUI Altsasu

evConversionPlans: Magyar Suzuki plans to introduce five new electric models by 2030. The Esztergom assembly plant is undergoing technological and decarbonization upgrades to serve as a primary production hub for these future electric vehicles.
name: SUZUKI Esztergom

evConversionPlans: The Kopřivnice plant produces the Tatra Force e-Drive line, including fully battery-electric 8x8 heavy-duty trucks. The facility is developing hydrogen fuel cell and plug-in hybrid powertrains while reaching a production capacity of 3,000 vehicles annually.
name: TATRA Koprivnice

evConversionPlans: The Grünheide Gigafactory produces electric vehicles and battery modules. Tesla is doubling production capacity to 1 million vehicles annually through 2026. Future expansions include full battery cell production targeting 8 GWh by 2027, a new R&D center, and enhanced logistical infrastructure.
name: TESLA MOTORS Grünheide

evConversionPlans: The Ovar plant produced approximately 250 to 260 units of the Toyota Accessible People Mover (APM). This electric microcar was developed to provide inclusive mobility for the Paris 2024 Olympic and Paralympic Games.
name: TOYOTA CAETANO PORTUGAL Ovar

evConversionPlans: Toyota Kolin has expanded its facility to 173,000 square meters to produce a new battery electric vehicle (BEV) and complete battery systems. The site includes a dedicated battery assembly facility as well as new paint and welding shops.
name: TOYOTA MOTOR EUROPE Kolin

evConversionPlans: The Vila Nova de Gaia facility produces battery electric and hydrogen fuel cell buses. Current initiatives through 2026 include expanding zero-emission production capacity and launching a new generation of electric city and articulated buses featuring CATL battery systems.
name: TOYOTA MOTOR EUROPE Vila Nova de Gaia (Porto)

evConversionPlans: Toyota's Wałbrzych site features a 25,000-square-meter Circular Factory opened in 2026. The facility processes 20,000 end-of-life vehicles annually to recover, recycle, and refurbish traction batteries and other components.
name: TOYOTA MOTOR EUROPE Wałbrzych

evConversionPlans: The Valeo facility in Czechowice-Dziedzice produces electric motors and high-voltage powertrains. Following a major expansion and conversion in 2021, the site provides specialized support for electric vehicle production.
name: VALEO SIEMENS eAUTOMOTIVE Czechowice-Dziedzice

brands: AMG, Mercedes-Benz; Lithium-ion battery modules and battery packs
evConversionPlans: The Uusikaupunki facility operates a major EV battery plant. Following the 2024 spinoff of the battery business into IONCOR, the Finnish State acquired a 70% majority stake in 2025. The site focuses on developing and commercializing modular battery systems for heavy-duty transport, commercial vehicles, and the automotive industry.
name: VALMET AUTOMOTIVE Uusikaupunki

evConversionPlans: Vanwall (ByKolles Racing) is assembling a limited 500-unit run of the Vandervell S and Vandervell S Plus electric hatchbacks at its Greding facility. There are no plans for a broader facility conversion or mass EV and battery production through 2026.
name: VANWALL Greding

evConversionPlans: VDL Bus & Coach operates a 27,000m² production facility in Roeselare dedicated to the new-generation electric Citea city bus. The plant has an annual capacity of 800 units and became the company's centralized hub for all city bus production in September 2025.
name: VDL GROUP Roeselare

brands: mini, midi bus by VDL Bus & Coach
evConversionPlans: VDL Special Vehicles in Born focuses on vehicle electrification, zero-emission heavy vehicles, and battery assembly. In Greenport Venlo, VDL Parree operates a 24,500-square-meter factory opened in 2026 for plastic automotive components, including EV battery cladding.
name: VDL GROUP Venlo

evConversionPlans: The Bratislava site is an EV hub with a target annual production of 250,000 MEB-platform vehicles. The facility launched the fully electric Porsche Cayenne in 2026 and receives battery packs from a dedicated facility in Horná Streda.
name: VOLKSWAGEN GROUP Bratislava

evConversionPlans: Volkswagen is transitioning its Chemnitz plant to produce thermal management systems for electric vehicles. Production of these e-mobility components was scheduled to begin by the middle of the decade, while internal combustion engine production continues concurrently.
name: VOLKSWAGEN GROUP Chemnitz

evConversionPlans: The Emden plant is an exclusive electric vehicle facility producing the ID.4, ID.7, and ID.7 Tourer. As of late 2024, the site transitioned to a pure EV assembly site by ceasing all combustion-engine vehicle production.
name: VOLKSWAGEN GROUP Emden

evConversionPlans: Audi Hungaria's Győr facility has expanded to manufacture MEB ECO electric motors for Volkswagen Group's compact EVs, with series production commenced in the first half of 2026. The plant also produces rotors, plate packs, and power electronics alongside its existing production of Premium Platform Electric (PPE) motors.
name: VOLKSWAGEN GROUP Győr

evConversionPlans: The Volkswagen Hannover plant produces the ID. Buzz and ID. Buzz Cargo. The facility assembles MEB battery systems, manufactures fast-charging stations, and produces three premium electric D-SUVs. As of 2026, production includes the ID. California camper and autonomous Level 4 ID. Buzz vehicles.
name: VOLKSWAGEN GROUP Hannover

evConversionPlans: The Böllinger Höfe site in Heilbronn assembles the all-electric Audi e-tron GT. Since 2024, the facility has included battery module production for the Volkswagen Group’s Scalable Systems Platform, with a capacity of 1,000 modules per day.
name: VOLKSWAGEN GROUP Heilbronn

evConversionPlans: The Ingolstadt site produces the Q6 e-tron and high-voltage batteries, having achieved net carbon-neutral production in 2024. As part of the 360factory strategy, the facility is beginning production of a new entry-level compact electric vehicle in 2026.
name: VOLKSWAGEN GROUP Ingolstadt

evConversionPlans: The Kvasiny factory is undergoing conversion from internal combustion engine assembly to electric vehicle production. This transition supports the scheduled launch of new fully electric models by 2028.
name: VOLKSWAGEN GROUP Kvasiny

evConversionPlans: Volkswagen is converting the Pamplona assembly site into a multi-brand electric vehicle factory. Beginning in 2026, the facility produces small MEB platform EVs, including the Volkswagen ID.2 and the Skoda Epiq.
name: VOLKSWAGEN GROUP Landaben (Pamplona)

evConversionPlans: The Leipzig plant began series production of the all-electric Macan in May 2024. The facility utilizes a flexible production line capable of manufacturing electric, hybrid, and combustion engine vehicles.
name: VOLKSWAGEN GROUP Leipzig

evConversionPlans: Volkswagen Martorell is transitioning to produce the Electric Urban Car family, including the CUPRA Raval and Volkswagen ID. 2all, with mass production starting in 2026. The site features a new battery assembly facility with an annual capacity of 300,000 units.
name: VOLKSWAGEN GROUP Martorell

evConversionPlans: The Mladá Boleslav plant features a 55,000 square meter battery assembly hall with an annual capacity of 335,000 units. The facility supports the production of 200,000 electric vehicles annually, including the Epiq and Peaq models launched in 2026.
name: VOLKSWAGEN GROUP Mladá Boleslav

evConversionPlans: MAN Truck & Bus began series production of battery-electric trucks at its Munich plant in June 2025. The facility features an integrated production line for both electric and diesel heavy-duty trucks, with a maximum capacity of 100 units per day.
name: VOLKSWAGEN GROUP Munich

evConversionPlans: The Neckarsulm plant is transitioning to full EV production under the 360factory strategy. Currently producing the e-tron GT, the facility is undergoing upgrades for next-generation electric vehicles and operates a battery module production site at Böllinger Höfe.
name: VOLKSWAGEN GROUP Neckarsulm

evConversionPlans: MAN Truck & Bus SE is developing an automated battery factory in Niepolomice with a planned annual capacity of over 200,000 units by 2030. The project includes an expansion of the existing assembly plant to support electric truck generations and mobility components.

name: VOLKSWAGEN GROUP Niepołomice

evConversionPlans: The Volkswagen Palmela plant is scheduled to begin production of the ID.1 entry-level EV in mid-2027. The facility is transitioning to a Zero Impact Factory utilizing robotic battery assembly and geothermal energy.

evConversionPlans: Volkswagen is expanding its Września plant to produce the next-generation all-electric Crafter (eCrafter). The project includes a new 35,000 square meter body shop and a 24,000 square meter battery-storage facility, with completion scheduled for mid-2027.

evConversionPlans: The Sant'Agata Bolognese site is undergoing expansion under the 'Direzione Cor Tauri' program to support electric vehicle production. evConversionPlans: The Södertälje facility produces heavy-duty electric trucks and battery modules using Northvolt cells. evConversionPlans: The Starachowice facility produces the MAN Lion's City E fully electric city bus. Since 2024, the plant has expanded production to include the Lion's Chassis E, a fully electric bus chassis for global markets.

evConversionPlans: The Stuttgart-Zuffenhausen plant serves as a smart factory for the mixed production of combustion and electric sports cars, including the all-electric 718 models. name: VOLKSWAGEN GROUP Stuttgart-Zuffenhausen

evConversionPlans: The Wolfsburg plant serves as an e-mobility hub, with full production of the all-electric ID.3 that commenced in 2024. evConversionPlans: Volkswagen Commercial Vehicles is expanding its Września plant to produce the next-generation all-electric Crafter (eCrafter). evConversionPlans: The Zwickau facility is a 100% electric vehicle production site that transitioned from internal combustion engines in 2022. It serves as a central competence center for the circular economy, specializing in vehicle dismantling and EV component reuse.

evConversionPlans: Traton is considering the Scania assembly site in Zwolle for a potential battery assembly plant for heavy-duty electric trucks. The facility would produce up to 100,000 battery modules annually, with production potentially starting by the early 2030s.

evConversionPlans: The Blainville-sur-Orne facility mass-produces medium-duty electric trucks for Volvo and Renault Trucks. In 2026, the plant expanded operations to include production of the Renault Trucks E-Tech D, an ultra-compact electric truck for urban deliveries.

evConversionPlans: The Bourg-en-Bresse plant produces heavy-duty Renault Trucks E-Tech T and C electric models. The facility features a 5,200-square-meter battery and drive unit assembly area, with production of a new 600-kilometer range long-haul electric truck scheduled for 2026.

evConversionPlans: The Ghent facility produces the fully electric EX30 and EX30 Cross Country.
